ChargerID/Serial No.
:

Problem Description
: FW Update
Troubleshooting
:
The charger has been successfully updated to the latest firmware version
v7.0.5
. However, we’ve observed active error flags on both dispenser outlets.
This issue may be related to a PLC communication error, specifically: Modbus communication with the dispenser PLC is down.
Check the ethernet connection to dispenser PLC, ethernet wiring, and also check if dispenser PLC CPU is in run mode. It may be possible that the dispenser-plc has not completed cold start and hence ethernet routers do not have power supply. Check if temperature sensors connected to dispenser PLC are operating correctly if this is the case.
